issue.title: Taxonomic hierarchy incorrect for certain cases

summary.text: At L1, the evidence shows the bug was reproduced: a test fails before the fix and passes after it, with no regressions or breaking inputs found, but the tests did not kill enough mutants to reach L2 and the guard stage reported the fix as not guarded. The most important thing to check next is the output changes in kraken_biom.handle_program_options and kraken_biom.main, which the Judge labelled s…
